ot_hbm3e_phy.note: HBM3E PHY analog (digital layer = HBM controller qkd_ctrl/qkd_ctrl_pc)

ot_qfd_serdes_112g_x12_phy.note: host SerDes PHY analog (digital layer = host link adapter in qkd_host)

ot_qkvd_ucie_x64_phy.note: UCIe x64 PHY analog (digital layer = D2D adapter: framing/credits ot_qkvd_d2d, CRC/retry/FEC)

qkd_astk.note: ot_qwen_nearhbm_attn_stack_d minus its engines (re-cut D: q beat broadcast, node staging, P.V levels 4-7; recut.json)

qkd_astk_n.note: as qkd_astk, N-stack pin plan (hub words on the S face)

qkd_ckbump.note: clock / reset bump pair to the ROM die (pad cell, no logic: by design)

qkd_ctrl.note: qfd_ctrl (r21c element; pcport KVW 2: KV write side-band from the CDC completion; kc: the stream-command word from qkd_seq -> async FIFO -> hclk ot_qkvd_kcmd_tap chain -> the 32 per-PC heads)

qkd_ctrl_n.note: as qkd_ctrl, N-stack pin plan (kc on the N face)

qkd_embgw.note: ot_qfd_emb_gw + the gateway link side (r21c hub link FIFOs)

qkd_land_n.note: as qkd_land (N stacks: pin plan level with the N-stack peers)
